gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-faculty-glyphi: Faculty Glyphic reads low and soft, a plain sans with rounded openings. Red Hat Display draws wire-cut strokes that hold up in big sizes, while the body font is happiest in running text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-judson: Dignified is the mood Judson sets, with brush-lifted curve ends and sturdy stems against fine hairlines. Judson carries a classic serif body of oversized small letters, so a longer passage feels bookish and full-bodied beside the marker-like Red Hat Display.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-snippet: Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with daylight inside every curve, bold and contemporary. And Snippet follows with crescent-wrench c shapes and a wire-bent feel, which makes the plain sans body approachable.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-instrument-sans: Red Hat Display holds one marker-like width throughout, with visible daylight inside each curve. And Instrument Sans carries a longer passage in a plain sans that never varies its stroke, with a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-montserrat: Red Hat Display keeps a marker-like line, with daylight showing inside every curve. Montserrat then adds the quality that lifts the pair: generous white space leading into oversized e and a counters, a sans that glides like wire.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-newsreader: Authoritative is the mood Newsreader brings, with open jaws on each curve and only a restrained shift between stem and connecting stroke. A longer passage stays refined beside Red Hat Display, a heading with no hairlines at all.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-nunito-sans: Bold, hairline-free letters up top, soft open-mouthed curves below: Red Hat Display sits over a low, gentle Nunito Sans. Give the heading a generous size and let the sans-serif text stay modest.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-outfit: Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line, contemporary and bold, with visible daylight inside every curve. Outfit follows with curves that finish before they close, cable-bent and unswelling, and that is the strongest quality of this sans-serif pair.
gen-fs-rosaline-nunito-sans: Nunito Sans sets soft, open-mouthed curves in small letters, quiet and neutral. And Rosaline, a flowing pen-written script with closed, sharp-edged forms, gives a handful of lines a luxurious lift above that sans-serif.
gen-fs-rx-100-fs-paquito: Paquito reads low and confident, a serif with hardly any gap between lowercase and caps. RX100 crowds its twine-like strokes into a futuristic, compact run, while Paquito is the one for a handful of lines of text.
